title: 10.3.0 | Terrifier PTB Patch Notes
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/791e1db915286933472cb443b07096ddfecf986b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h2][b]New Killer: The Terrifier[/b][/h2][p][b]Power: Bag of Toys[/b]
Hold the [i]Ability button[/i] to open your [b]Bag of Toys[/b] and select one of two random [b]Toys[/b]. The [b]Bag of Toys[/b] enters a cooldown state and cannot be opened again until it expires.

[b]Special Items: Toys[/b]
[b]Toys[/b] damage healthy Survivors and inflict injured Survivors with a [b]Torture[/b] effect. Hold the [i]Power button[/i] to ready a [b]Toy[/b] and tap the [i]Attack button[/i] to use it. Each [b]Toy[/b] is single-use.

[b]Acid Bottle[/b]: Throw [b]Acid Bottles[/b] at Survivors or create [b]Acid Puddles[/b]. Causes the [b]Torture[/b] effect.
[b]Flail[/b]: Perform a sweeping attack that can strike over certain obstacles. Causes the[b] Torture[/b] effect.
[b]Handgun[/b]: Fire a bullet. Causes the[b] Torture[/b] effect.
[b]Flamethrower[/b]: Shoot a stream of fire that can inflame Pallets, Windows, and Generators. Causes the[b] Torture[/b] effect.
[b]Bike Horn[/b]: Reveal Survivors with [b]Killer Instinct[/b] and apply [b]Oblivious[/b] for [b]X seconds[/b]. Reset the timer on any active [b]Torture[/b] effects.

Use a Toy to inflict a Torture effect on an injured Survivor. Then, use a different Toy on the Survivor to down them and inflict Terrified.

[b]Special Action: Taunt[/b]
Press the [i]Ability button[/i] to [b]Taunt[/b]. Taunting a [b]Terrified[/b] Survivor who is hooked or downed grants 1 point of [b]Deadliness[/b] to all [b]Toys[/b]. This removes the Survivor's [b]Terrified[/b] status effect.

[b]Deadliness[/b]
When a [b]Toy[/b] applies the [b]Torture[/b] status effect, it gains one point of [b]Deadliness[/b]. Upon reaching maximum [b]Deadliness[/b], the [b]Toy[/b] can down injured Survivors.
When the [b]Bike Horn[/b] reaches maximum [b]Deadliness[/b] it will interrupt any Survivors repairing a Generator or healing, and instantly regress their progress.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Killer Perks:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Laughingstock[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Survivors within [b]12m[/b] of a completed Generator:[/p][list][*][p]Gain [b]Exhausted[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Gain [b]Oblivious[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]When they leave this range, the effect lingers for [b]3/4/5s[/b].[/p][p]You see the Auras of completed Generators.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Kill Spree[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]When all remaining Survivors have 2 Hook States and all Generators are completed, you can kill Survivors.[/p][p]While killing a Survivor,[b] [/b]both Exit Gate Switches are blocked. Whenever you finish killing a Survivor, this ends after [b]6/8/10s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Funny Business[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Whenever you damage a Generator, you gain [b]10%[/b] [b]Haste [/b]for [b]10s [/b]and one of the following occurs at random:[/p][list][*][p]You retain your [b]10%[/b] [b]Haste [/b]for [b]5s [/b]longer.[/p][/*][*][p]You get stunned for [b]2s.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The affected Generator is blocked for [b]30s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Confetti! But nothing happens.[/p][/*][/list][p]Cooldown: [b]60/50/40s[/b].[/p][p]The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Survivor: Sienna Shaw[/b][/h2][h2]New Survivor Perks:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Valkyrie's Rage[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]After being chased for [b]40/35/30s[/b], the next time you pallet-stun the Killer, they are stunned for [b]75%[/b] longer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shared Trauma:[/p][list][*][p]Whenever you take a protection hit, all Survivors within [b]12m[/b] recover from [b]Exhausted [/b]while running for [b]30/35/40s[/b].[/p][p]Within [b]32m[/b], you see the Auras of [b]Exhausted [/b]Survivors.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Best Gift Ever[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]At the start of the trial, you earn [b]4/5/6[/b] Tokens.[/p][p]The first time you drop an Item of each type, spend 1 Token, then the dropped item is consumed (by the Entity). Then, based on the item type:[/p][list][*][p]Flashlight - whenever you stun the Killer, they are also blinded for [b]2s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fog Vial - whenever you fast-vault, for [b]5s[/b], your scratch marks disappear [b]50%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Key - you gain [b]+1[/b] rummage on each chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Map - Auras you see for a duration last [b]+1s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Medkit - while healing another Survivor, you also gain healing progress at [b]25%[/b] speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Toolbox - you see the Auras of the [b]3 [/b]Generators closest to each other.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Map: Hartshorne Mall[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Introducing the The Subdivisions realm with the Hartshorne Mall, a new environment loaded with lore where players can experience a new environment in Dead by Daylight.
"Dwight was no older than five when he lost his parents in the Hartshorne Mall. A place that was once a magical escape twisted into something more horrifying. He ducked behind a door marked 'Employees Only', and found himself somewhere completely different: somewhere quiet, but no less disturbing. Something called out to him. He followed the call... and woke up at home, his parents pleading him to tell where he went. He did not answer. He could not remember."[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Features[/b][/h1][h3][b]Gore Customization[/b][/h3][p]You can now customize the gore settings under the Gameplay tab in the Settings menu.[/p][p][b]Death Sequences[/b] can be toggled to reduce their goriness.[/p][p][b]Natural Blood Color[/b] can be toggled to a neutral green tone.[/p][p][b]Regional Streamer Mode[/b], in addition to toggling the above, will anonymize all player information.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Mori System Update[/b][/h3][p]We have defined three distinct Mori categories to provide better activation constraints and also allow more flexibility in their artistic direction. These categories are:[/p][list][*][p]Finisher mori[/p][/*][*][p]Power mori[/p][/*][*][p]Memento Mori offering and Perk mori[/p][/*][/list][p]Starting with The Terrifier, all upcoming Killers will adhere to this Mori system update.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] Not all Killers have or will have a Power mori, but rather that any Moris they do have will fall into these categories.[/p][/*][/list][p]Each mori type is superseded by the one above it, as long as the trigger conditions are all met, meaning only a single "Kill" interaction prompt is available at one time.[/p][p]Activating all moris will use a standardized keybinding of the Killer's Attack input.[/p][p]This system update will roll out to previously released Killers over time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Redeem code popup[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Prevent players from spamming the redeem button for a promo code that might already be expired[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Tally Screen:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improvements to the widgets in the player list[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Content Updates[/b][/h1][p]With the 10.2.0 patch, we released a lot of perk updates. We're doing a few improvements to some of them. Additionally, we were conservative with some of the numbers and after reviewing, we felt they could be buffed further.[/p][h3][b]Survivor Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Dark Sense[/b][/p][list][*][p]When the trial starts, and after a Generator is completed, you earn [b]1[/b] Token, up to [b]5[/b]. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]When the Killer gets within 20m of you, spend [b]1[/b] Token. Then, for the next 13/14/15s:[/p][list][*][p]You see the Aura of Pallets and Windows within 32m[/p][/*][*][p]You see the Auras of other Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]You see the Killer's Aura.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Dark Sense was updated as a generic alternative to reveal pallets and windows within a radius. In 10.2.0, it activated upon generator completion, meaning if it didn't get a chance to trigger, players would lose value. With this PTB, we are adding a token system to allow players to have more chances to activate the perk.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Calm Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]You do not scare Crows or scream.[/p][/*][*][p]You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, and [b]23/24/25[/b]% faster. [i](was 8/9/10%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Slippery Meat[/b][/p][list][*][p]Other Survivors unhook you [b]65/70/75[/b]% faster. [i](was 90/95/100%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you are unhooked, you gain [b]7[/b]% more Haste. [i](was 5%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Slippery Meat had the possibility to eliminate risk for the Survivor unhooking you. With this PTB, we are shifting some of its strength from the Unhook Speed to the Haste bonus after being Unhooked.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Dark Arrogance[/b][/p][list][*][p]You basic-vault Windows [b]15[/b]% faster. [i](was 25%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Your successful basic-attack cooldown is [b]13/14/15[/b]% shorter. [i](was all forms of basic-attack recovery and 10%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you are blinded, Pallet-stunned, or miss a basic-attack the duration is [b]15[/b]% longer. [i](was only blind/stun and 25%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Dark Arrogance regained its successful basic-attack cooldown in 10.2.2, but we felt it could be buffed a little further. To offset this, we're reducing the vault speed bonus while also decreasing the penalty to blinds, pallet stuns, and we're adding missed attack cooldowns to the penalties.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Ravenous[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token. For each token:[/p][list][*][p]Gain 4% Haste while carrying Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Hook Survivors 4% faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When you have 4 Tokens, all Survivors:[/p][list][*][p]Scream.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gain Exposed for [b]60/65/70[/b]s. [i](was 80/85/90s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Once upon a time, Vigil drastically decreased a lot of Status Effects, including Exposed. In a post-Vigil world, we felt the Exposed duration was a little too long.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Whispers[/b][/p][list][*][p]While within 28/26/24m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers.[/p][/*][*][p]While outside of 28/26/24m of a Survivor, you gain [b]7[/b]% Haste. [i](was 5%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Bot Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with Survivor Bots trying to cleanse totems when a Player is already interacting with it.[/p][/*][*][p]Tentative fix for Survivor Bots not unhooking while walking into the hooked Survivor.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Characters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the aura of completed generators became visible after controlling Victor (The Twins) during the End Game Collapse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment was able to block a Survivor from escaping past the 32m range.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera was too far away from The Good Guy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where injured Survivors hit by The Slasher's spike would not always get correctly pinned to nearby surfaces.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Raccoon City Police Station where a Killer can block a hook and prevent a Survivor from unhooking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Pale Rose where a Survivor could not interact with one side of a generator in the corner of the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Grim Pantry where collisions were missing under the stairs of the small structure.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Temple of Purgation where the Nurse could not blink through some walls in the underground section.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Disturbed Ward where Survivors are clipping through the doors of lockers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Lay Waste had the Generator regression speed increase applied before other Generator regression Perks were triggered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Merciless Storm caused a Skill Check to automatically fail after the second Skill Check when playing against The Doctor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there was an inconsistency in the activation of Hex: The Third Seal.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the perk Chemical Trap was unable to explode when placed on a pallet at the same time it was being broken by certain Killer Powers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Wiggle Skill Check Bar was starting at an incorrect position.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Onryo Condemned HUD indicator remained dim after a TV teleportation near a Survivor with active stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a Bloodweb Error would frequently occur when selecting the Loadout Tab while the Bloodweb was progressing.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Best Gift Ever - Deathslinger gets blinded when his chain breaks if the Survivor has the Flashlight "buff"[/p][/*][*][p]The vignette of Blood when failing a Skill check on a hook is red instead of green when the Natural Blood Color Setting is turned off.[/p][/*][*][p]The Singularity's biopod splashes white when being created or destroyed with Natural Blood color options set to Off.[/p][/*][*][p]The blood from Moris remains red with the blood color Gore adjustment setting active for some killers when the Natural Blood Setting is turned Off.[/p][/*][*][p]The Terrifier mori tracker does not change state when a power mori is used.[/p][/*][*][p]Opening match details shows incorrect information.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional polish on The Terrifier Moris animations and VFX is ongoing.[/p][/*][*][p]Terrifier Power description does not specify that Horn Oblivious and Deadliness Score only trigger when multiple Survivors are detected.[/p][/*][*][p]Applying Terrified to a Survivor affected by Endurance displays the Terrified VFX while they remain Injured.[/p][/*][*][p]Terrifier's camera shakes temporally after interrupting a survivor from vaulting.[/p][/*][*][p]Misaligned animation during the Survivors Pick Up interaction.[/p][/*][/list]
